name: utilbox

scripts.build: node scripts/copy-pdf-worker.mjs && npm run generate:tools && next build
scripts.validate: node scripts/validate-registry.mjs && node scripts/check-icons.mjs && node scripts/check-branding.mjs && node scripts/check-titles.mjs && node scripts/contrast.mjs
scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-lib.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-expression.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-ooxml.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/verify-examples.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run validate && npm test

description: Free browser-based utilities: PDF tools, calculators, image tools, converters, generators, text tools and developer tools.
